notes: οὐκ and οὐδέ are aligned separately to *not* and *nor*; neither governs a negative indefinite, so rules 41 and 59 do not arise.
*over* is given to ἀνδρός as the genitive's case preposition rather than read as part of a phrasal *have dominion over* (rules 21, 36).
αὐθεντεῖν → *to have dominion* heads on the meaning-bearing complement under rule 17's support-verb clause.
διδάσκειν and εἶναι keep their own infinitival *to* under rule 61's closing clause, no conjunction governing either.
